title: Starting trombone in the Tucson High School orchestra
summary: With the concert band full, he took a $12 trombone for the high school orchestra and has played it ever since.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: You went to Tucson High School there, and how was it as far as your playing music? You started playing the trombone at that time?

Yes. I tell ya how I got to the trombone. I, I went to the band master in Tucson High School, and they were all filled up, every instrument, and I couldn't, I couldn't join the concert band. So they said, "However, we have an opening for a trombonist if you play trombone, we have a opening for a -- in the orchestra." So I said, I said, "Well, I know, I know how to play trombone ,but I got a good back-ground. I don't think it'll take long for me to play trombone." And incidentally, there was another Pima Indian in the Tuscon High School Orchestra, and a very distant relative. The name is Walker. And, well I, I got a -- my brother bought me a $12 trombone. And I'll never forget that. I started with the trombone in the high school orchestra, although I didn't know a thing about it, but I could play the other instruments, and all I had to do was learn the positions and get my embouchure for the trombone. That was my first introduction to the trombone. I have never left it until now.
